_comment: 优化项与预设的唯一数据源。C# GUI 与 PowerShell CLI 都从这里加载；修改时只改本文件。
_i18n: name/description/sideEffect 为中文（zh-CN），*En 为英文（en-US）。英文缺失时界面回退中文，绝不显示空白。详见 docs/dev/PLAN-P2-1-catalog-i18n.md。

items.name: 关闭鼠标加速
items.description: 关闭 Windows 指针精度增强（MouseSpeed=0），鼠标 1:1 原始移动，定位更稳。注销或重启后完全生效。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off Windows pointer precision enhancement (MouseSpeed=0) so the mouse moves 1:1 with no smoothing, giving steadier aim. Fully effective after signing out or restarting.
items.sideEffect: 桌面鼠标手感会变"跟手"；不习惯可在系统设置改回。
items.sideEffectEn: The cursor will feel more direct on the desktop. Revert in Windows settings if you dislike it.

items.name: 键盘缓冲区扩容
items.description: 键盘类设备驱动缓冲从 20 提升到 50，高键盘负载(连打/宏)下降低输入延迟与丢键。重启生效。
items.descriptionEn: Raises the keyboard class driver buffer from 20 to 50, cutting input latency and dropped keystrokes under heavy keyboard load (rapid tapping or macros). Requires a restart.
items.sideEffect: 内存占用几乎不变；个别老外设驱动理论兼容面变窄，可还原。
items.sideEffectEn: Memory use is essentially unchanged. A few older peripheral drivers may be marginally less compatible. Reversible.

items.name: 键盘重复提速
items.description: 按键重复延迟调到最短(KeyboardDelay=0)、重复速率保持最高，长按退格/移动更跟手。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the key repeat delay to its shortest (KeyboardDelay=0) while keeping the repeat rate at maximum, so holding backspace or a movement key responds faster.
items.sideEffect: 打字手感变化；不习惯可在"控制面板-键盘"调回。
items.sideEffectEn: Changes how typing feels. Adjust it back under Control Panel, Keyboard, if you dislike it.

items.name: 关闭粘滞键/切换键弹窗
items.nameEn: Disable Sticky Keys and Toggle Keys prompts
items.description: 关闭粘滞键与切换键，游戏中连按 5 次 Shift 或 Win 不再弹窗打断。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off Sticky Keys and Toggle Keys, so pressing Shift or Win five times in a row no longer interrupts a game with a prompt.
items.sideEffect: 需要辅助功能的用户请勿开启本项。
items.sideEffectEn: Do not enable this if you rely on accessibility features.

items.name: 开启硬件加速 GPU 计划（HAGS）
items.description: HwSchMode=2，让 GPU 调度走硬件队列，降低部分场景的输入延迟与掉帧。
items.descriptionEn: Sets HwSchMode=2 so GPU scheduling runs through a hardware queue, reducing input latency and dropped frames in some scenarios.
items.sideEffect: 个别老驱动下可能蓝屏，属已知兼容性风险；出现异常可随时还原。
items.sideEffectEn: A few older drivers can bugcheck with this enabled, a known compatibility risk. Restore at any time if you hit problems.

items.name: 关闭窗口透明特效
items.description: 关闭任务栏/窗口亚克力透明，省一点 GPU 开销。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off taskbar and window acrylic transparency to save a little GPU overhead.
items.sideEffect: 桌面观感变朴素。
items.sideEffectEn: The desktop looks plainer.

items.name: 禁用游戏全屏优化
items.description: 为游戏主程序在 AppCompat 层加 DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE，绕过全屏优化合成层。
items.descriptionEn: Adds DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE at the AppCompat layer for the game executable, bypassing the fullscreen optimization composition layer.
items.sideEffect: Alt+Tab 切换可能略慢；需要先找到游戏主程序路径，找不到则跳过。
items.sideEffectEn: Alt+Tab may feel slightly slower. Requires locating the game executable; skipped if it cannot be found.

items.name: 游戏强制使用高性能 GPU
items.nameEn: Force games onto the high-performance GPU
items.description: 在 DirectX UserGpuPreferences 中把游戏指定到高性能 GPU（双显卡笔记本关键）。
items.descriptionEn: Assigns the game to the high-performance GPU in DirectX UserGpuPreferences. Important on dual-GPU laptops.

items.name: 禁用 MPO 多平面叠加
items.description: DWM OverlayTestMode=5，规避已知的 MPO 闪烁/掉帧问题。
items.descriptionEn: Sets DWM OverlayTestMode=5 to work around known MPO flicker and frame-drop issues.
items.sideEffect: 个别 HDR/多屏场景显示行为可能不同。
items.sideEffectEn: Some HDR or multi-monitor setups may behave differently.

items.name: 禁止显卡动态降频
items.description: 在主显卡驱动键写入 DisableDynamicPstate=1，锁住 GPU 频率避免波动掉帧。
items.descriptionEn: Writes DisableDynamicPstate=1 to the primary GPU driver key to hold clocks steady and avoid frequency-related frame drops.
items.sideEffect: 待机功耗与发热升高；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Raises idle power draw and heat. Off by default.

items.name: 解除多媒体网络限流
items.description: NetworkThrottlingIndex=0xffffffff，去掉 Windows 对多媒体流量的节流，降低网络延迟抖动。
items.descriptionEn: Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex=0xffffffff to remove Windows throttling of multimedia traffic, reducing network latency jitter.

items.name: 关闭 Nagle 算法(TcpAckFrequency)
items.description: 对所有网卡接口启用 TCP_NODELAY 并将 ACK 频率设为 1，降低在线游戏网络往返延迟。
items.descriptionEn: Enables TCP_NODELAY on every network interface and sets the ACK frequency to 1, reducing round-trip latency in online games.
items.sideEffect: 小包发送频率上升，上传带宽占用略增；对下载速度无影响。
items.sideEffectEn: Small packets are sent more often, slightly increasing upload overhead. Download speed is unaffected.

items.name: 电源计划 → 卓越性能
items.description: 切换到"卓越性能"电源计划（系统无可用方案时自动创建一份），让 CPU 更积极跑满频率。
items.descriptionEn: Switches to the Ultimate Performance power plan, creating one if the system has none, so the CPU holds higher clocks more aggressively.
items.sideEffect: 功耗与发热略升；笔记本续航变短。
items.sideEffectEn: Slightly higher power draw and heat; shorter battery life on laptops.

items.name: 电源计划隐藏项调优
items.description: 解除隐藏并调整两项影响性能的电源参数：关闭 USB3 链路省电、处理器性能提升模式设为激进。
items.descriptionEn: Unhides and adjusts two performance-affecting power parameters: disables USB 3 link power saving, and sets the processor performance boost mode to Aggressive.
items.sideEffect: 功耗略升；不支持的 CPU 平台自动跳过，不报错。
items.sideEffectEn: Slightly higher power draw. Automatically skipped without error on unsupported CPU platforms.

items.name: 禁用 USB 选择性暂停
items.description: 全局禁用 USB 选择性暂停，杜绝鼠标键盘被系统休眠导致的首发延迟/掉帧。
items.descriptionEn: Disables USB selective suspend globally so Windows cannot put the mouse and keyboard to sleep, avoiding first-input latency and stutter.
items.sideEffect: 整机 USB 功耗略增；笔记本电池续航变短。
items.sideEffectEn: Slightly higher overall USB power draw; shorter battery life on laptops.

items.name: 开启 Windows 游戏模式
items.description: 允许系统在游戏运行时优先分配 CPU/GPU 资源。
items.descriptionEn: Lets Windows prioritise CPU and GPU resources while a game is running.

items.name: 关闭 Xbox 后台录制
items.description: 关掉 Game Bar 后台录制（DVR），减少游戏时的后台编码负载。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off Game Bar background recording (DVR) to cut background encoding load while gaming.
items.sideEffect: Win+G 录制/截图功能不可用。
items.sideEffectEn: Win+G recording and capture become unavailable.

items.name: 前台进程调度权重提升
items.description: Win32PrioritySeparation=0x28（短/变长量子、前台提升 2），让前台游戏进程获得更高调度优先级。
items.descriptionEn: Sets Win32PrioritySeparation=0x28 (short, variable-length quanta with foreground boost 2) so the foreground game gets higher scheduling priority.
items.sideEffect: 个别软件在后台时响应变慢。
items.sideEffectEn: A few applications may respond more slowly in the background.

items.name: 关闭 Windows 错误报告
items.description: 关闭 WER 弹窗与后台转储，减少崩溃时的磁盘/CPU 开销。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off WER dialogs and background dumps, cutting disk and CPU work when something crashes.
items.sideEffect: 程序崩溃时不再有系统级提示窗口。
items.sideEffectEn: No system-level prompt appears when a program crashes.

items.name: 系统后台响应保留设为最低
items.nameEn: Set system background responsiveness to minimum
items.description: SystemResponsiveness=10（MMCSS 文档允许的最低值），把更多 CPU 留给前台游戏。
items.descriptionEn: Sets SystemResponsiveness=10, the lowest value MMCSS documents, leaving more CPU for the foreground game.
items.sideEffect: 后台任务（解压、杀毒扫描）响应略慢。
items.sideEffectEn: Background tasks such as unzipping or antivirus scans respond a little more slowly.

items.name: MMCSS 游戏任务档位拉满
items.nameEn: Max out MMCSS game task priority
items.description: 把多媒体类"游戏"任务的 GPU/CPU 调度权重设为最高档（收益微弱但零副作用）。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the multimedia Games task GPU and CPU scheduling priority to its highest level. A small benefit with no side effects.

items.name: 禁用 SysMain（预取）服务
items.description: 把 SysMain 服务启动类型设为禁用（Start=4）。SSD 时代预取收益有限，省一点后台 IO。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the SysMain service startup type to Disabled (Start=4). Prefetching buys little on SSDs, so this saves some background I/O.
items.sideEffect: 系统启动后程序冷启动略慢；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Applications start a little more slowly after boot. Off by default.

items.name: 禁用 Windows Search 索引
items.description: 把 Windows Search 服务设为禁用（Start=4），减少索引后台占用。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the Windows Search service to Disabled (Start=4) to cut background indexing load.
items.sideEffect: 开始菜单/资源管理器搜索明显变慢；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Start menu and File Explorer search become noticeably slower. Off by default.

items.name: 关闭休眠与快速启动
items.description: powercfg /h off，删除休眠文件，加快启动并腾出磁盘；快速启动随之失效。
items.descriptionEn: Runs powercfg /h off to delete the hibernation file, speeding up boot and freeing disk space. Fast Startup stops working as a result.
items.sideEffect: 合盖只剩睡眠（无休眠）；开机冷启动略慢；笔记本默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Closing the lid leaves only sleep, with no hibernate; cold boot is slightly slower. Off by default on laptops.

items.name: 游戏进程 CPU 优先级提到高
items.nameEn: Raise the game process CPU priority to High
items.description: 通过 IFEO PerfOptions 让游戏进程启动即以高优先级运行（CpuPriorityClass=3）。
items.descriptionEn: Uses IFEO PerfOptions to start the game process at High priority (CpuPriorityClass=3).
items.sideEffect: 对指定进程生效；多开/直播同机时可能影响其他程序。
items.sideEffectEn: Applies only to the specified process. May affect other programs when running multiple instances or streaming on the same machine.

items.name: 内核代码常驻内存
items.nameEn: Keep kernel code resident in memory
items.description: DisablePagingExecutive=1，不让内核与驱动代码分页到磁盘，减少关键路径的磁盘等待。
items.descriptionEn: Sets DisablePagingExecutive=1 so kernel and driver code is not paged to disk, reducing disk waits on critical paths.
items.sideEffect: 多占少量常驻内存（通常几十 MB，可忽略）。
items.sideEffectEn: Uses a little more resident memory, typically tens of MB, which is negligible.

items.name: 关闭内存压缩
items.description: EnableCompression=0，关闭内存压缩与页面合并（压缩省内存但耗 CPU；内存充足时关掉可能更稳）。
items.descriptionEn: Sets EnableCompression=0 to turn off memory compression and page combining. Compression saves memory but costs CPU, so disabling it can be steadier when you have plenty of RAM.
items.sideEffect: 内存占用上升；仅供手动对比，默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Memory usage goes up. Intended for manual comparison only; off by default.

items.name: 禁用动态计时器
items.description: bcdedit disabledynamictick yes，让系统以固定高频率计时，减少延迟抖动。
items.descriptionEn: Runs bcdedit disabledynamictick yes so the system ticks at a fixed high rate, reducing latency jitter.
items.sideEffect: 待机功耗略升；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Slightly higher idle power draw. Off by default.

items.name: 菜单弹出零延迟
items.description: 右键/下拉菜单显示延迟从 400ms 归零，系统操作更干脆。
items.descriptionEn: Cuts the right-click and drop-down menu show delay from 400 ms to zero for snappier system interaction.
items.sideEffect: 几乎无负面影响。
items.sideEffectEn: Essentially no downside.

items.name: 视觉效果最佳性能
items.description: 将 Windows 视觉效果方案切换为"调整为最佳性能"，关闭动画与花哨特效，桌面合成开销降到最低。
items.descriptionEn: Switches the Windows visual effects scheme to Adjust for best performance, turning off animations and decorative effects to minimise desktop composition overhead.
items.sideEffect: 窗口动画、阴影等观感变朴素；可在系统"性能选项"调回。
items.sideEffectEn: Window animations and shadows disappear, so the desktop looks plainer. Revert under Windows Performance Options.

items.name: 关闭传递优化 P2P 上传
items.description: 禁止 Windows 更新等组件把已下载内容 P2P 上传给局域网/互联网其他设备，释放上行带宽降低游戏延迟抖动。
items.descriptionEn: Stops Windows Update and similar components from P2P-uploading downloaded content to other devices on your LAN or the internet, freeing upload bandwidth and reducing latency jitter.
items.sideEffect: 系统自身下载不再为其他设备加速。
items.sideEffectEn: Your own downloads no longer help speed up other devices.

items.name: 关闭桌面应用后台运行
items.nameEn: Stop desktop apps from running in the background
items.description: 禁止应用在后台运行，减少后台 CPU/网络占用与电量消耗，前台游戏资源更集中。
items.descriptionEn: Prevents apps from running in the background, cutting background CPU and network use and battery drain so the foreground game gets more resources.
items.sideEffect: 应用的通知/后台同步可能不即时。
items.sideEffectEn: App notifications and background sync may not be immediate.

items.name: 关闭诊断遥测
items.description: 将诊断数据收集设为最低档，减少后台遥测上报带来的零星磁盘/网络活动。
items.descriptionEn: Sets diagnostic data collection to the lowest level, reducing the occasional disk and network activity caused by telemetry uploads.
items.sideEffect: 部分反馈功能不可用。
items.sideEffectEn: Some feedback features become unavailable.
